## Schema

### Optional

- `account_group_name` (String) Name of the account group which owns the test that is generating the units
- `test_name` (String) Name of the test generating usage
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `aid` (String) Unique ID of the account group owning the test that is generating units
- `cloud_units_projected` (Number) Cloud Units projected in the current usage period, based on units consumed to date and configuration of the test
- `cloud_units_used` (Number) Units generated by the by the cloud agents running the test
- `enterprise_units_projected` (Number) Enterprise Units projected in the current usage period, based on units consumed to date and configuration of the test
- `enterprise_units_used` (Number) Units generated by the by the enterprise agents running the test
- `is_instant_test` (Boolean) Indicates whether the test is scheduled or instant
- `test_id` (String) Unique ID of the test generating usage
- `test_type` (String) Type of test generating usage. Note that this is a friendly testType entry (so it shouldn’t be parsed to discover the correct operation to query for configuration details).

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`
